title: MAT Provider Configuration — bundle manifest
description: Machine-readable index for MAT-16. Defines LLM provider configuration for model-agnostic agent orchestration.
notes: Provider config is separate from repo profiles (MAT-9) — one config can be shared across repos.
Auth credentials are NEVER stored in this config — only env var names that reference them.
Model aliases let orchestrators reference 'orchestrator', 'worker', etc. without hardcoding model IDs.
Fallback chains enable graceful degradation when a provider is unavailable.
